items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I went with Jimmie Noone... for me to work with Jimmie Noone, and that'd be the last band I worked with in Chicago, and then from the Jimmie Noone band, I went to New York

ctx.x: Chuck Beale was playing piano around Chicago, too, and Charlie Beale was playing with Jimmy Noone, and for some reason, Jimmy Noone and I swapped jobs, and I mean, Charlie Beale and I swapped jobs and it was okay with Jimmie and it was okay with Armstrong. So Charlie Beale went with Armstrong, and I went with Jimmie Noone; but Jimmie Noone was another one of my idols, too.

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he came to Detroit once with Jimmy Noon's band, and I never heard of him

ctx.x: The Ruby at Club, with Zinky Cohn on the piano. Oh, you guys -- I used to hear you on the radio, and Zinky was -- well, I had heard Zinky, but he came to Detroit once with Jimmy Noon's band, and I never heard of him, and I was just knocked out by the way Zinky played the piano.
Well, he was the same sound like --
